ERR_REMOTE_NOT_WIRED.message: Board {board} is not reached by a cable now: its wired devices do not wait for their answers
ERR_REMOTE_NOT_WIRED.hint: The program's timing has changed. Check the cable to that board.

ERR_REMOTE_LOST.message: {count} events or errors of a device of board {board} were lost on the way
ERR_REMOTE_LOST.hint: The link to that board is busy or bad.

ERR_REMOTE_SUBS_FULL.message: Device {id} cannot be followed: {max} subscriptions to this board's devices already
ERR_REMOTE_SUBS_FULL.hint: Remove a remote device of this board on another board, or allow more subscriptions.

ERR_REMOTE_ALIASES_FULL.message: Events and errors of a device of board {board} are not shown: {max} remote devices with events already
ERR_REMOTE_ALIASES_FULL.hint: Its calls still work. Remove another remote device, or allow more.
